start.text: The last locker clicks shut. In the quiet that follows, a folded note slips from your sleeve and lands between your shoes.

note-1.speaker: Hana
note-1.text: You found it. I was starting to think it fell behind the lockers.

question.prompt: The note is still in your hand. Hana watches you, trying not to look as nervous as she does.

read-1.speaker: Hana
read-1.text: Oh. You weren't supposed to read that part.

read-2.text: The ink is uneven, as if the writer changed their mind halfway through.

return-1.speaker: Hana
return-1.text: Thank you. Maybe I'll finish it first, next time.

ending-read.title: Ink and Courage
ending-read.text: Some words are easier to write than to say. Some are easier to read than to return.

ending-return.title: A Quiet Return
ending-return.text: She folds the note away, and the hallway feels a little less empty.
